organization.name: Expensify, Inc.
organization.notes: Founded 2008, incorporated Delaware 2009; company public on Nasdaq since November 2021. OpenView Series C is a historical investment; current holding not established.

pricingTiers.name: Collect
pricingTiers.notes: New Collect workspace rate; US $5/member/month with no annual commitment or card requirement, confirmed by official announcement. Free Submit is separate.

pricingTiers.name: Collect
pricingTiers.notes: Explicitly Most popular; monthly flat membership rate, not active-seat legacy billing.

pricingTiers.name: Control
pricingTiers.notes: Closest advanced organizational tier. Custom pricing advertised as low as $9/active member/month; depends on commitment/card terms, so no universal monthly or annual amount asserted.
No separately named Enterprise plan in reviewed pricing; larger organizations use custom Control pricing.

moats.claim: Receipt-to-reimbursement, card and ledger connections can make a mature expense approval workflow costly to replace.

productReasons.claim: SmartScan receipt capture and mileage tracking reduce manual expense-report preparation.
Card feeds, reconciliation and accounting integrations connect card spend to the books.
Multiple approval flows and custom expense rules in Control support more complex spending policies.
